{{Top|Leg}}
'''Hypergleamum glands''' were artificial glands implanted into the brain for use with the [[Neuro-Saav Corporation|Neuro-Saav]] [[Hifold Sensory Package]]. Together with [[true-fleck brain implant]]s, the artificial hypergleamum glands released chemicals to help the recipient of the Hifold system understand the increased sensory input.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''</ref>
